evidence.exact_span: An adjournment application was sought today by the applicant. The basis of the application seemed to be that the applicant wanted the opportunity to seek legal aid.
By notice of motion and affidavit filed 19 December 2006 the applicant seeks to set aside the orders made by this Court on 21 November 2006.
In my view the Federal Magistrates Court decision discloses no error.
